A Horrible Earthquake

一场可怕的地震 · 162 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Dirty water rose in wells and canals before the earthquake. But no one realised that an earthquake was coming. Suddenly, everything shook. It seemed as if the world was at an end. Millions of brick houses and a number of dams were destroyed. Railway tracks were reduced to useless metal bars. Pipes in mines burst and let out smelly steam. Huge cracks trapped cyclists everywhere.

2The next day, the event made headlines in every newspaper. As reporters gave an outline of the disaster, the whole nation was shocked by the damage and the victims’ extreme suffering. People were moved when they read that the survivors comforted each other by saying, “Congratulations! You survived!” So they sincerely expressed their sympathy and organised help for the victims right away. The injured were rescued and the dead were buried. The frightened survivors were dug out from under the ruins and were offered shelter, fresh water and electricity. Thanks to people’s help, the loss was minimized.

高考英语3500词 · 04中文译文

一场可怕的地震

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1地震前，井里和水渠里的脏水涨了上来。谁也没想到地震即将发生。突然，所有东西都摇晃起来，仿佛世界就要毁灭。数百万栋砖房和许多水坝被毁，铁路钢轨成了毫无用处的铁条。矿井里的管道爆裂，喷出难闻的蒸汽。到处都有巨大的裂缝，骑车的人被困在路上。

2第二天，各家报纸都把这件事放在头条。记者报道了灾情概况，全国的人都为破坏的程度和灾民的苦难感到震惊。看到幸存者互相安慰说“恭喜，你活下来了！”，大家深受感动。他们表达了真切的同情，马上组织起来援助灾民。伤者获救，遇难者得到安葬。惊魂未定的幸存者从废墟下被挖出来，有了住处、干净的水和电。多亏大家伸出援手，灾害造成的损失才尽量降了下来。
